item.text: {"summary":"Treat carriage return as ASCII whitespace during splitting.","explanation":"The failing test shows that the ASCII whitespace delimiter omits '\\r', leaving it as a separate field. Add it to the delimiter's whitespace character set so Windows line endings split consistently.","edits":[{"path":"absl/strings/str_split.h","old":"\" \\t\\n\\f\\v\"","new":"\" \\t\\n\\r\\f\\v\""}]}
